.NET 10.0.13

Release

What's Changed

  • [release/10.0] Fix InlinedCallFrameMarker bit-0 check on 64-bit platforms in DAC stack walk by @jkotas in #131961
  • [release/10.0] Fix transition from monomorphic to polymorphic VSD by @AndyAyersMS in #132626
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #132653
  • [release/10.0] Fix sporadic AccessViolation in compressed single-file apps on Apple Silicon by @elinor-fung in #132710
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #132790
  • [release/10.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/xharness by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #132684
  • [release/10.0] Fix internal Helix queue selection by @jozkee in #132907
  • [release/10.0] JIT: only imply non-null assertions from exact-type assertions by @EgorBo in #132628
  • [release/10.0] JIT: don't use a jump-threaded block's sharpened predicate for dominator-based inference by @EgorBo in #132629
  • [release/10.0] JIT: fix switch peeling stealing the wrong operand of its compare by @EgorBo in #132631
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #132881
  • [release/10.0] Update dependencies from dotnet/xharness by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #132961
  • [release/10.0] Avoid writing jitdump code for block data by @steveisok in #133048
  • [Release/10.0] Initialize debugger sequence map before binding patches by @hoyosjs in #133073
  • [release/10.0] Use lock-free reads for ETW rundown versions by @tommcdon in #133084
  • [release/10.0] Fix profiler spurious/corrupt transition callbacks for reverse P/Invoke marshaling stubs. by @lateralusX in #131928
  • [release/10.0] Don't pass empty string as SNI to QUIC by @rzikm in #133162
  • [release/10.0] Detect ephemeral client cert key via SEC_E_UNKNOWN_CREDENTIALS in QUIC by @github-actions[bot] in #132974
  • [release/10.0] Fix hang in InvalidClientRequestTests by guarding oversized Content-Length cases to managed implementation by @github-actions[bot] in #132782
  • [release/10.0] Fix concurrent Reflection.Emit TypeLoadException (#129230) by @github-actions[bot] in #132673
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #133074
  • [release/10.0] Implement SocketsHttpHandler.InitialHttp2MaxConcurrentStreams by @MihaZupan in #133091
  • [release/10.0] [mono][interp] Fix miscompile of self-assignment via newobj with alised byref args. (#131586) by @lateralusX in #131927
  • [release/10.0] Use acquire reads for cast cache entries by @github-actions[bot] in #133053
  • [release/10.0] Fix ConcurrentQueue.TryDequeue spuriously reporting empty during a segment freeze- #132737 by @VSadov in #132897
  • [release/10.0] [S.T.J] Fix PropertyRef.Equals by @github-actions[bot] in #133061
  • [release/10.0] Fix Crossgen2 variance validation for type constraints by @jtschuster in #133118
  • [release/10.0] Fix SIMD primitive zero initialization by @tannergooding in #133170
  • [release/10.0] Release ThreadStore lock before blocking for shutdown by @github-actions[bot] in #133182
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #133223
  • [release/10.0] Check for SIG_IGN and SIG_DFL before calling previous signal handler by @github-actions[bot] in #133177
  • [release/10.0] [Android] Disable X509 name-constraint violation tests on Android by @github-actions[bot] in #133233
  • [release/10.0] Fix X509 reference leak in SslStream extra chain certificates on Unix by @github-actions[bot] in #132760
  • [release/10.0] Improve PemEncoding.TryFind perf with degenerate inputs by @github-actions[bot] in #133250
  • [release/10.0] Deduplicate "all managed object wrappers" mapping by @github-actions[bot] in #133292
  • [release/10.0] Fix crossgen2 rejecting input files with uppercase .DLL/.EXE extensions by @github-actions[bot] in #132895
  • [release/10.0] Fix SIMD MinMax constant special cases by @tannergooding in #133257
  • [release/10.0] JIT: Add visit budget checks to IsMonotonicallyIncreasing and ComputeDoesOverflow by @EgorBo in #133161
